lead.event: Indonesia’s PMK 67/2026 permits government cash placements in banks and securities
lead.headline: PMK 67/2026 allows government cash placements in banks and securities
lead.blurb: The regulation replaces PMK 44/2024, allowing excess central government cash, including the Budget Surplus Balance, to go into commercial banks and State Securities, with Bank Indonesia no longer listed as a destination. Mirae Asset Sekuritas says placements have recently been concentrated in state-owned banks, creating withdrawal risk if funds are needed for budget spending. Banking LDR was 92.7% in August, or 97.2% excluding SAL placements. The analyst remains selective on state-owned banks and names BCA (BBCA) and Bank Syariah Indonesia (BRIS) as top sector picks.

deals_control.event: INDY considers selling Kideco coal mine to potential buyers
deals_control.headline: INDY reportedly considers selling Kideco for more than US$1 billion
deals_control.blurb: Indika Energy is reportedly weighing a sale of Kideco, in which it holds a 91% stake. Bumi Resources, Rio Tinto and Emirates Global Aluminium are named as potential buyers, though Indika and Bumi declined to comment.

deals_control.event: SILO completes first stage of Rp6.91 trillion First REIT transaction
deals_control.headline: SILO completes first stage of Rp6.91 trillion First REIT transaction
deals_control.blurb: The transaction with First REIT could reduce Siloam’s lease expenses and increase its control over strategic assets. The net-profit impact depends on the funding structure, added interest costs and depreciation.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TBIG plans Rp2.37 trillion bond and sukuk issuance to repay loans
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TBIG plans Rp2.37 trillion bond and sukuk issue to repay loans
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Tower Bersama plans Rp1.24 trillion of bonds and Rp1.12 trillion of sukuk, with net proceeds earmarked for loans from UOB Indonesia and Mizuho Indonesia. The loans mature on 19 October 2026, with sukuk proceeds covering the remaining UOB debt and Rp408.89 billion owed to Mizuho.

macro_flows.event: Danantara prepares $1 billion investment in stocks and bonds
macro_flows.headline: Danantara prepares $1 billion investment in stocks and bonds by year-end
macro_flows.blurb: Public Investment Head Rani Piputri said the fund may buy domestic shares when temporary external sentiment puts the market under pressure. Danantara has already invested roughly $3 billion in stocks and bonds across domestic and foreign markets.

earnings_guidance.event: TEBE reports coal-loading growth and explores fuel-oil trading
earnings_guidance.headline: TEBE reports 810,000 tons of coal loading and seeks fuel-oil trading license
earnings_guidance.blurb: Dana Brata Luhur attributed increased loading to higher production by mining-permit customers after the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources approved their 2026 RKABs. Subsidiary Talenta Bumi completed its first coal-trading shipment of 7,400 metric tons, while Talenta Bumi Energi is applying for a fuel-oil trading license.
